A '''sculptor''' created a [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]] bust of [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], the last [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. While working on the bust, the [[Sculptor/Legends|sculptor]] was guided by [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
